scope: Real authenticated owner results HTTP including complete response body and JSON parse; a page is bounded after the change, global summaries remain equal.

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 7.5.0-3ubuntu1~18.04) 7.5.0, 64-bit

methodology.latency: fetch through text decoding and JSON parse; assertions and byte counting excluded
methodology.resources: Owned API child only; CPU tick differences exclude client/PostgreSQL/Redis. RSS peak includes startup/warmup.
methodology.limits: 20 samples per repeat: p99 is maximum; shared host; first page only; no steady-state/general production capacity claim. No throttle counters reset or policy changed.

plans.sql:
SELECT t.*, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM enterprise_attempts a WHERE a.test_id = t.id) AS attempt_count,
  ARRAY(SELECT u.username FROM users u WHERE u.id = ANY(t.invite_user_ids) ORDER BY lower(u.username)) AS invite_usernames,
  coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('problemId', v.problem_id, 'version', v.version) ORDER BY v.position)
    FROM enterprise_problem_versions v WHERE v.test_id=t.id), '[]') AS problem_versions FROM enterprise_tests t WHERE t.id = $1

SELECT a.*, u.username,
              coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
                'problemId', s.problem_id, 'solved', s.solved,
                'submissions', s.count, 'submissionId', s.submission_id
              )) FILTER (WHERE s.problem_id IS NOT NULL), '[]') AS problems
         FROM enterprise_attempts a
         JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id
         LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
           SELECT problem_id, bool_or(status = 'ACCEPTED') AS solved, count(*)::int AS count,
                  (array_agg(id ORDER BY (status = 'ACCEPTED') DESC, created_at DESC))[1] AS submission_id
             FROM submissions WHERE attempt_id = a.id GROUP BY problem_id
         ) s ON true
        WHERE a.test_id = $1
        GROUP BY a.id, u.username
        ORDER BY a.started_at
SELECT id,enterprise_attempt_id,challenge_id,submitted_at,state->'report' AS report FROM vibe_attempts WHERE enterprise_attempt_id=ANY($1::uuid[])
